query: I have a 73-year-old female to evaluate. Among female Medicare patients aged 68–78 at admission admitted from the emergency department with a principal hemorrhagic stroke (ICD‑9/10) and documented discharge, how many index admissions meet these cohort criteria in the dataset?
final_sql:
WITH cohort AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.hadm_id
  FROM `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.admissions` a
  INNER JOIN `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.patients` p
    ON a.subject_id = p.subject_id
  INNER JOIN `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.diagnoses_icd` d
    ON a.subject_id = d.subject_id AND a.hadm_id = d.hadm_id
  WHERE p.gender = 'F'
    AND a.insurance = 'Medicare'
    AND a.admission_location = 'EMERGENCY ROOM'
    AND d.seq_num = 1
    AND (
      (d.icd_version = 9 AND d.icd_code IN ('430', '431', '432'))
      OR
      (d.icd_version = 10 AND (d.icd_code LIKE 'I60%' OR d.icd_code LIKE 'I61%' OR d.icd_code LIKE 'I62%'))
    )
    AND (p.anchor_age + EXTRACT(YEAR FROM a.admittime) - p.anchor_year) BETWEEN 68 AND 78
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_index_admissions
FROM cohort;
